title: MX Frontmatter Schema v1.2
description: JSON Schema for validating .mx file YAML frontmatter (version 1.2). Core field values are natural language prose, ISO timestamps, BCP 47 tags, or SHA-256 hash scalars. Application-specific extensions use the x_ prefix and are not validated here.

mx_version.description: Must be exactly '1.2' for this version.

source.description: Source filename, path, or URL. Optional.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source markdown body. Format: sha256:<64 lowercase hex chars>

mx_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of comprehension layer content + generation metadata. Used for offline tamper detection. See spec section 4.2 for exact computation.

model.description: AI model identifier used for generation (e.g., 'qwen3-8b-instruct').

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the source content.

gist.description: 3-5 sentence summary. No jargon. Maximum 1,000 characters.

script.description: Conversational script written for spoken delivery. 250-350 words recommended.

audio_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of associated audio file. Content hash only — not a URL.

eli5.description: Plain everyday vocabulary explanation. 100-200 words. Analogy-first.

manually_edited.description: True if any comprehension layer has been modified by a human after generation.

edit_history.description: Ordered list of edit events. Items are open objects.

guidance.description: Human-provided authoring guidance. Open object — additional fields allowed.

type.description: Set to 'project' for multi-file project MX.

files.description: Constituent files in a project MX.

relationships.description: Cross-file relationships in a project MX.

$comment: additionalProperties is true to allow x_ prefixed extension fields (e.g., x_gistmx_sig for application-layer cryptographic signing). Extension fields are out of scope for this specification and must be ignored by conforming consumers that do not understand them.
